hunks.baseline: I didn’t know exactly what it was, but at least I wasn’t feeling either one.
hunks.sol: I didn’t know exactly what it was, but I wasn’t feeling either one.

hunks.baseline: In that sense, unlike them, I was standing on the peak. I could see and feel more, and from farther away.
hunks.sol: Unlike them, I stood on a peak. From there, I could see farther and sense more.

hunks.baseline: And that wasn’t a privilege I enjoyed alone.
hunks.sol: And I wasn’t the only one.

hunks.baseline: Magic Johnson, who’d been saving his strength by focusing on defense in the rear, had a grim look on his face. So did Yamamoto Genji, an S-rank Hunter at least in name, and Team Leader Choi, whose Qi Sense was nearly as sharp.
hunks.sol: Magic Johnson, who’d been saving his strength by focusing on defense in the rear, looked grim. So did Yamamoto Genji, an S-rank Hunter at least in name, and Team Leader Choi, whose Qi Sense was nearly as sharp as his.

hunks.baseline: Through the countless grains falling back down, I saw the Hunters’ faces. They looked as if they’d just been doused in cold water.
hunks.sol: Through the falling sand, I saw the Hunters’ faces. They looked as if they’d just been doused in cold water.

hunks.baseline: “What are you all scared of? You all that eager to die?”
hunks.sol: “What are you all scared of? You that eager to die?”

hunks.baseline: “Call them whatever rank you like—they’re still monsters. And we’re all still Hunters. So quit freezing up like you’re about to die and…”
hunks.sol: “However you rank them, they’re still monsters. And we’re all still Hunters. So quit freezing up like you’re about to die and…”

hunks.baseline: I drove a dagger into the head of an ogre that was still writhing, stubbornly clinging to its life, then continued with emphasis.
hunks.sol: I drove a dagger into the head of an ogre still writhing and clinging stubbornly to life, then finished my sentence.

hunks.baseline: One Against a Thousand was the Title I’d earned while fighting the Arch Lich’s army in Sichuan Province. As a reward for accomplishing such a rare feat, it was definitely effective.
hunks.sol: One Against a Thousand was the Title I’d earned while fighting the Arch Lich’s army in Sichuan Province. For a reward earned through such a rare feat, it certainly delivered.

hunks.baseline: A few Hunters who’d been swallowing nervously until now roared, their eyes bloodshot. A tremendous cheer soon erupted, heating the air around us.
hunks.sol: A few Hunters who’d been swallowing nervously until now roared, their eyes bloodshot. A tremendous cheer followed, heating the air around us.

hunks.baseline: I clicked my tongue softly at the sight of Yamamoto Genji rubbing his shin where I’d kicked it, watching me warily. Then I turned my eyes toward the monster army stretching endlessly across the vast desert.
hunks.sol: I clicked my tongue at the sight of Yamamoto Genji rubbing his shin and watching me warily. Then I turned toward the monster army stretching endlessly across the desert.

hunks.baseline: A force of well over ten thousand marched with measured precision, splitting to the left and right. Three paths opened, and at last, the beings radiating an overwhelming presence appeared.
hunks.sol: A force of well over ten thousand marched with measured precision, parting to the left and right. Three paths opened, and at last, the beings radiating an overwhelming presence appeared.

hunks.baseline: But the powerful demonic qi and Fear pouring from them were as immense as that of all these countless monsters combined.
hunks.sol: But the demonic qi and Fear pouring from them were as overwhelming as all those countless monsters put together.

hunks.baseline: Enough to make even Yamamoto Genji afraid, despite his cowardice and lack of skill—or, at least, despite his being an S-rank Hunter in name.
hunks.sol: Enough to frighten even Yamamoto Genji. Cowardly and less capable though he was, he was still an S-rank Hunter.

hunks.baseline: “So those are the commanders leading this monster army.”
hunks.sol: “So those are the commanders leading this monster army,” the Skeleton King murmured.

hunks.baseline: At the Skeleton King’s murmur, I spoke up.

hunks.baseline: To be honest, the same was true for me.
hunks.sol: To be honest, neither had I.

hunks.baseline: Given how meticulous the bastard was, he was probably watching everything unfold from some distance away.
hunks.sol: Given how meticulous the bastard was, he’d be watching everything unfold, even if he kept his distance.

hunks.sol: On top of that, the monster army’s momentum had changed with the arrival of its S-rank commanders. It was nothing like before.

hunks.baseline: Magic Johnson’s low voice reached my ears. His eyes had sunk deep, as if he could already guess what the battle about to begin again would cost us.
hunks.sol: Magic Johnson’s low voice reached my ears. The look in his eyes suggested he knew what the battle about to begin again would cost us.

hunks.baseline: And he was worried about me, the one who would have to bear the weight of it all.
hunks.sol: He was worried about me, too—the one who would have to bear it all.

hunks.baseline: I stared silently at Magic Johnson for a brief moment, then shook my head.
hunks.sol: I stared silently at Magic Johnson for a moment, then shook my head.

hunks.baseline: Of course, Magic Johnson had all the skill and qualifications for it. He was a veteran who’d lived through the Great Cataclysm and a fine commander who’d led his forces to victory in around a dozen major battles.
hunks.sol: Of course, Magic Johnson had the skill and the qualifications. He was a veteran of the Great Cataclysm and a fine commander who’d led his forces to victory in more than ten major battles.

hunks.baseline: “If there’s something I have to bear, I won’t push it onto someone else.”
hunks.sol: “If it’s mine to bear, I won’t push it onto someone else.”

hunks.baseline: The voice that followed held firm trust and the faintest trace of a smile.
hunks.sol: When he spoke, I heard firm trust and the faintest trace of a smile.

hunks.baseline: A thousand Hunters in all. I didn’t know all their names or faces.
hunks.sol: A thousand Hunters in all. I didn’t know every name or every face.

hunks.baseline: If I died, they would, too.
hunks.sol: If I died, they’d do the same for me.

hunks.baseline: “From now on, I’ll dispense with the formalities, Magic Johnson.”
hunks.sol: “I’m dropping the formalities now, Magic Johnson.”

hunks.baseline: “Keep the enemies in the air in check and focus on protecting our allies. All subordinate Hunters are to follow Magic Johnson’s orders until I give them another command.”
hunks.sol: “Keep the enemies in the air in check and focus on protecting our allies. The Hunters under you are to follow your orders until I say otherwise.”

hunks.sol: In an instant too brief to measure, I gripped the spear in reverse and drove it down like a streak of light.

hunks.baseline: At the unseen enemy who’d crept up from deep in the desert without anyone noticing.
hunks.sol: At an unseen enemy that had approached from deep in the desert without anyone noticing.

hunks.sol: Countless scorpions as large as grown men—and one scorpion larger than dozens of them put together.
